vacancies.title: Vacancies
vacancies.description: Every vacancy in the product, whoever created it.

empty.title: No vacancies yet
empty.description: Create a vacancy, or wait for a coordinator to create one.

noMatches.title: Nothing matches those filters
noMatches.description: Clear the filters to see every vacancy again.

detail.questionsLegacy: Kept from an older vacancy. A new vacancy asks nothing beyond the reusable profile.

fields.title: Title
fields.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens. It becomes part of the public link.
fields.summaryHelp: One or two sentences, shown in listings.
fields.organizationHelp: Only a verified organization can have its vacancies published.
fields.capacityHelp: How many volunteers this vacancy needs. At least one.
fields.estimatedTotalHoursHelp: Hours a volunteer earns for the whole event.
fields.locationNameHelp: The venue on site, or a public description of where the work happens online. Never a meeting password.
fields.cityHelp: Required when volunteers turn up in person.

form.createDescription: A new vacancy starts as a draft. An administrator approves it before any volunteer sees it.
form.noOrganizations: No organization is available yet, so a vacancy cannot be created. Ask an administrator to add one.
form.unverifiedNotice: This organization is not verified yet. A vacancy under it cannot be approved until an administrator verifies it.
form.editDescription: Changes stay a draft until the vacancy is sent for approval again.

archive.title: Archive this vacancy?
archive.description: It stops accepting applications and disappears from the public list. This cannot be undone from here.

vacancies.archivedNotice: This vacancy is archived. It can no longer be edited.

submit.title: Send this vacancy for approval?
submit.description: An administrator decides whether it is published. You cannot edit it while it is under review.
submit.success: The vacancy was sent for approval.

publish.title: Publish this vacancy?
publish.description: Volunteers will see it immediately and can apply until the deadline.

approval.title: Approval
approval.description: An administrator decides whether this vacancy reaches volunteers.
approval.pendingDescription: Approve and publish this vacancy, request changes, or reject it permanently.
approval.changesDescription: Edit the vacancy and send it for approval again.
approval.rejectedDescription: It stays read-only. Create a new vacancy instead.
approval.missingDescription: Fill these in before sending it:
approval.readyBlocked: This vacancy is not ready yet
approval.readyLine: Everything approval needs is in place.

decide.noteHelp: Required when you request changes or reject. The coordinator reads it on the vacancy.
decide.queueEmpty: No vacancy is waiting for approval.
decide.noteRequiredHelp: Required. The coordinator reads it on the vacancy.

approve.title: Approve and publish this vacancy?
approve.description: Volunteers will see it straight away and can start applying.
approve.success: The vacancy was approved and published.

requestChanges.title: Send this vacancy back for changes?
requestChanges.description: The coordinator can edit it and send it for approval again. Say what has to change.
requestChanges.success: The vacancy was sent back for changes.

reject.title: Reject this vacancy permanently?
reject.description: It becomes read-only for good — the coordinator cannot edit it or send it again. Say why.

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.description: Applications appear here once volunteers apply to your published vacancies.

noMatches.title: Nothing matches those filters
noMatches.description: Clear the filters to see every application again.

detail.snapshotNote: This is the profile the volunteer submitted with the application, not their profile today.

review.title: Record a decision
review.noteHelp: Optional. The volunteer can read this.

draft.title: Not sent yet
draft.description: The volunteer started this application but hasn't sent it, so there is nothing to decide yet.

withdrawn.title: Withdrawn by the volunteer
withdrawn.description: The volunteer took this application back, so no decision is needed.

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: This decision is final. The volunteer sees it as “Not selected”.

closed.title: Closed
closed.description: This decision is final. The volunteer sees it as “Closed”.

empty.title: No volunteers yet
empty.description: Volunteers appear here once they join and apply.

noMatches.title: No volunteer matches that search
noMatches.description: Clear the search to see everyone again.

detail.noApplications: This volunteer has no application to your vacancies.

password.title: Assign a temporary password
password.description: This replaces the volunteer's password and forces them to choose a new one at the next sign-in. Existing sessions end immediately.
password.privacy: An existing password can never be read, by anyone, here or in the API. Assigning a replacement is the only option.
password.label: Temporary password
password.help: At least 8 characters. Tell it to the volunteer over a channel you trust.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Confirm attendance and hours for any accepted volunteer.

empty.title: Nothing to confirm
empty.description: Accepted applications appear here when their attendance is still open.

table.caption: Accepted volunteers awaiting an attendance decision

resolve.title: Confirm attendance
resolve.description: This decision counts towards the volunteer's record, so it cannot be undone from here.

queue.total: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is waiting} one {# volunteer is waiting} other {# volunteers are waiting}}
queue.waiting: {count, plural, one {# volunteer to confirm} other {# volunteers to confirm}}
queue.opensAt: Opens {when}, once the event has ended.
queue.opensUnknown: Opens once the event has ended.
queue.resolvedCount: {count, plural, one {# volunteer already confirmed} other {# volunteers already confirmed}}

roster.title: Attendance
roster.description: Confirm who turned up once the event has ended.
roster.caption: Accepted volunteers and their attendance
roster.noAccepted: No volunteer has been accepted yet.
roster.closedDescription: It opens when the event ends, on {when}.
roster.closedUnknown: It opens when the event ends.
roster.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No one selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
roster.batchHelp: One outcome and one number of hours for everyone selected. Correct a single row afterwards.
roster.hoursHelp: Starts at the vacancy's estimated hours. Change it if the event ran shorter or longer.

activity.title: My activity
activity.description: Everything you did in this portal, newest first.

empty.title: No activity yet
empty.description: Creating a coordinator, publishing a vacancy or confirming attendance is recorded here.

noMatches.title: Nothing matches those filters
noMatches.description: Clear the filters to see the whole history again.

account.title: Change password
account.description: Choose a new password for your administrator account.

required.title: Choose a new password
required.description: An administrator gave you a temporary password. Change it before you can use the portal.

account.newPasswordHelp: At least 8 characters. Do not reuse a password from anywhere else.

coordinators.title: Coordinators
coordinators.description: Create coordinators, and block, unblock or remove the ones that exist.
coordinators.summaryDescription: Every coordinator across the product, by state — not only this page.

empty.title: No coordinators yet
empty.description: Create the first coordinator to start delegating vacancies.

noMatches.title: No coordinator matches those filters
noMatches.description: Clear the filters to see everyone again.

detail.noActivity: This coordinator has done nothing yet.

create.title: New coordinator
create.description: The coordinator signs in with this email address and the permanent password you set.
create.name: Full name
create.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. Share it over a trusted channel — it cannot be read back afterwards.
create.success: The coordinator was created and can keep using this password.

block.title: Block this coordinator?
block.description: They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in again until you unblock them. Their vacancies are untouched.

unblock.title: Unblock this coordinator?
unblock.description: They can sign in again with the password they already have.

remove.title: Remove this coordinator?
remove.description: They lose the coordinator role and every session ends. The record stays for the audit history.
remove.reassignHelp: Active vacancies must go to another active coordinator before this one can be removed.
remove.noCandidates: There is no other active coordinator to take the vacancies over. Create one first.

password.title: Assign a temporary password
password.description: This replaces the coordinator's password and forces them to choose a new one at the next sign-in. Existing sessions end immediately.
password.privacy: An existing password can never be read, by anyone, here or in the API. Assigning a replacement is the only option.
password.label: Temporary password
password.help: At least 8 characters. Tell it to the coordinator over a channel you trust.

coordinators.adminNotice: Administrators cannot be created, listed or reset here. That is deliberate: there is no web interface for it anywhere in this product.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: A vacancy can only be published under a verified organization.

empty.title: No organizations yet
empty.description: Add the first organization so vacancies have somewhere to belong.

noMatches.title: Nothing matches those filters
noMatches.description: Clear the filters to see every organization again.

fields.name: Name
fields.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens. It cannot be changed later.
fields.verifiedHelp: Only a verified organization can have its vacancies published.

create.title: New organization
create.description: Add the organization that vacancies will be published under. Its address cannot be changed later.

update.title: Edit organization
update.description: The address cannot be changed. Verification decides whether vacancies under this organization can be approved.

audit.title: Audit history
audit.description: Every recorded action, filtered by coordinator and by action.
